purpose: Real-world paired temporal-block benchmark of MG-GBC versus ARP-GB on UNSW-NB15.
evidence_tier: Expansion of the real-world experiment; not an external-generalization or cross-source claim.

source.name: UNSW-NB15
source.download_surface: Official UNSW SharePoint folder linked by the official page
source.version: No explicit version identifier exposed by the official download surface
source.license_note: Official page grants academic/public research use; commercial use requires agreement with the authors.

observed_source_profile_before_modeling.duplicate_policy: Preserve source rows. No stable Flow ID exists in the full CSVs, and the requested protocol does not authorize outcome- or duplicate-based row deletion. Report duplicate rates as a data-quality caveat.

sampling.eligible_block_rule: At least 5000 source rows with stime in [start, start + 300)
sampling.within_block_sampling: Uniform without replacement using seed 20260826 + block_index after block selection is frozen; no label is consulted.

features.flow_id_status: No Flow ID column exists in the four full official CSV shards.
features.categorical_rule: Per-block ordinal encoding with a missing token; fitted without labels.
features.numeric_missing_rule: Per-block median imputation; all-missing numeric columns become zero.
features.scaling: One common per-block min-max transform is computed once and the identical matrix is passed to both methods with internal scale=False.

labels_and_metrics.label_blinding: Labels are indexed only after the block and its 5000 sampled rows are fixed and the feature matrix is frozen.
labels_and_metrics.rare_class_rule: A true class with count < sqrt(5000); recall is computed after Hungarian matching.

aggregation.block_level: Save every method result for every selected block.
aggregation.source_level: Take medians across the 20 blocks before any source-level statement.
aggregation.independence_rule: The 20 blocks are repeated samples from one source and must never be counted as 20 independent datasets.

source_level_evaluation.primary_effect: Median paired delta ARI (MG-GBC minus ARP-GB) across the 20 frozen blocks.
secondary_effects: Median paired delta rare-recall on blocks where it is defined
Median paired delta rare-recall on blocks where MG-GBC detects at least one rare core
source_level_evaluation.interpretation: The 20 blocks quantify within-dataset stability and paired performance. They produce one UNSW-NB15 real-world benchmark result and must not be interpreted as 20 independent sources.
source_level_evaluation.cross_source_rules: Not evaluated in this run because only one dataset/source is in scope.

stopping_rule: Run all 20 frozen blocks and report every completed or failed method without block replacement or threshold changes.
